entry.title: Elastic Stack 8.15.2 released
entry.summary: Version 8.15.2 of the Elastic Stack was released today. We recommend you upgrade to this latest version. We recommend 8.15.2 over the previous version 8.15. Logstash 8.15.0 introduced a bug in Environment variable substitution which led to configurations breaking and preventing Logstash from starting. This issue has been fixed in 8.15.2. For more information see https://github.com/elastic/logstash/pull/16456. PyTorch is upgraded to version 2.3.1. This resolves some memory allocation issues related to the pytorch_inference process being terminated by the operating system Out Of Memory Killer. For more information see https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/110530 and https://github.com/elastic/ml-cpp/pull/2688 For details of the issues that have been fixed and a full list of changes for each product in this version, please refer to the release notes.
